# Skribly Projects

> The projects of the Skribly team: what each one is, what it is made of and where it stands.

The projects our team builds and will build. Each one has its own page: what it is, what it is made of and where it stands.

## Skribly

[Skribly](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/): Tools for people who write software with AI coding agents. Public: https://skribly.pl/. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/

### Its parts

- [skribly.pl](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/website/): The home page of Skribly, in English and Polish. Public: https://skribly.pl/. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/website/
- [Skribly Docs](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/docs/): The documentation of the Skribly tools, in English and Polish. Public: https://docs.skribly.pl/. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/docs/
- [Skribly UI](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/ui/): The shared look of Skribly: tokens, CSS, React components and the site kit. Public: https://ui.skribly.pl/. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/ui/
- [Skribly Agent](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/agent/): A desktop app for working with AI coding agents side by side. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/agent/
- [Skribly Tracker](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/tracker/): An issue tracker made to work with coding agents. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/tracker/
- [agent-skills](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/agent-skills/): Portable skills for AI coding agents, with one installer. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/agent-skills/
- [Skribly Core](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/core/): The shared contracts, API access and presets of the Skribly apps. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/core/
- [Skribly ID](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/id/): One sign-in for every Skribly app. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/id/
- [Skribly API](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/api/): One address for the REST APIs of the Skribly apps. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/api/
- [Skribly Hub](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/hub/): A console that shows the state of every Skribly product. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/hub/
- [Skribly Status](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/status/): Whether each public Skribly site is up. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/status/
- [Skribly Trust Centre](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/trust/): How Skribly handles security, privacy and accessibility. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/trust/
- [Skribly Tools](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/tools/): A list of the Skribly tools that are live. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/tools/
- [App template](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/template-app/): The starting point of every Skribly app. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/template-app/
- [Site template](https://projects.skribly.pl/skribly/template-site/): The starting point of every Skribly site. In progress. Polish: https://projects.skribly.pl/pl/skribly/template-site/

## Optional

- [Licences](https://projects.skribly.pl/licenses/): The open source software and fonts that this site ships, each with its licence and its licence text.
